name: agent-board
description: Agent Board session plugin: bash-mirror, kill-guard, artifact-register, plan-handoff-guard, sdd-call-guard and context-inject hooks, the agent-status mod (session state from events, read by the board), the team-band mod (who needs you, above the lead's prompt), the tmux-orchestrator and handoff skills, and the effort-* agent types. Loaded per session with --plugin-dir; nothing is installed into ~/.claude.
